label: Team 9 Traffic
info:
Ingests team9/traffic/sensors/# , validates JSON, stores to SQLite and feeds the dashboard.
Also subscribes to team9/traffic/signal/state and team9/traffic/timing/decisions published by the Python controller service (src/service/controller_service.py).
The Traffic Testing Lab publishes custom readings/commands to team9/traffic/test/input and displays the old-vs-new timing result from team9/traffic/test/result.

Requires (npm install in ~/.node-red):
  node-red-node-sqlite   (sqlite / sqlitedb nodes)
  node-red-dashboard     (ui_template / ui_chart nodes, v3+)
Core MQTT + validation + error handling work without them.
